options.name: config
options.description: A list of link layer discovery configurations

options.name: running_config
options.description: This option is used only with state I(parsed). The value of this option should be the output received from the NX-OS device by executing the command B(show running-config | include lldp). The state I(parsed) reads the configuration from C(running_config) option and transforms it into Ansible structured data as per the resource module's argspec and the value is then returned in the I(parsed) key within the result.

options.name: state
options.description: The state of the configuration after module completion. States C(replaced) and C(overridden) have the same behaviour for this module.
